bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "afb8a9e84f789fe180fb2452e3e64ffb684849ec"
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_integration.py -q >/dev/null
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_assistant.py -q >/dev/null
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
with urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8081/healthz",timeout=8) as response:
    assert response.status == 200
    data=json.load(response)
assert data["commit"]=="afb8a9e84f789fe180fb2452e3e64ffb684849ec",data
assert data["service"]=="tumblr-operation-app",data
assert data["ui"]=="authenticated",data
PY
